caption:
Your 24-hour reminder text is the industry default.

It's also why some of your booked appointments never show up.

A widely cited scheduling study tracking over 54,000 appointments found that adding an earlier reminder on top of the standard day-before text lowered the no-show rate from 5.8% to 4.4%.

Build the sequence this week:

1. At booking: confirm date, time, and service by text.

2. 3 days out: remind them and ask for a one-word reply, confirm or reschedule.

3. 1 day out: your highest-reply message. Confirm or reschedule again.

4. 2 hours out, high-value bookings only: one last nudge before estimates, consults, or test drives.

Every message needs an easy way to reschedule.

A client who reschedules frees the slot. A client who forgets costs you the slot and the job.
